# Google Shopping (4 endpoints)

## Endpoints

| Resource | Params | Credits | Description |
|----------|--------|---------|-------------|
| /product-search | `query` | 5 | Search Google Shopping products |
| /product | `product_id` / `gid` / `data_docid` | 1 | Get Google Shopping product detail |
| /reviews | `gid` | 1 | Get Google Shopping product reviews |
| /sellers | `product_id` / `gid` / `data_docid` | 1 | Get Google Shopping sellers for a product |

### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- `a`? — the spec marks nothing required, but these are the parameters the endpoint accepts;
  a bare call usually will not work. See Endpoint Details for which combination to send.
- *(none)* — takes no parameters at all.
- A method prefix (**POST**, **DELETE**, **PATCH**) marks a non-GET endpoint; unmarked rows are GET.
- Every endpoint also accepts the `Cache-Control` header (send `no-cache` to bypass the
  response cache — billed at the normal rate) and `Idempotency-Key` (a UUID that makes a
  retry safe; a replay returns the cached payload without double-billing).

## Endpoint Details

_What each endpoint returns and when to reach for it._

### /product-search — 5cr

Searches Google Shopping for products matching a keyword. Returns a unified ProductList with title, seller, price (current/original/currency), rating, image URLs, and the opaque product identifiers (id, ext.gid, ext.data_docid) required to fetch product detail, reviews, or sellers. Sourced from DataForSEO's task-based Merchant/Google API; the async lifecycle is handled server-side, so this is an ordinary synchronous request. First calls take ~20-30s, then serve from cache.

**Parameters**

- `query`: Product search keyword (e.g. 'wireless earbuds').
- `country` *(optional)*: Country as an ISO code ('US', 'GB') or full name ('United States'). Defaults to United States.
- `language` *(optional)*: Language code (e.g. 'en'). Defaults to en.
- `depth` *(optional)*: Number of product results to retrieve (default 40, max 120). More results = longer task time.
- `price_min` *(optional)*: Minimum product price filter.
- `price_max` *(optional)*: Maximum product price filter.
- `sort_by` *(optional)*: Result ordering: review_score, price_low_to_high, or price_high_to_low.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google_shopping/product-search?query=<query>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /product — 1cr

Returns the full detail for a single Google Shopping product: title, description, rating, image gallery, feature bullets, specifications (grouped name/value), and product variations. Pass any one of the opaque identifiers (product_id, gid, or data_docid) returned by /v1/google_shopping/product-search — all three are recommended for accuracy.

**Parameters**

- `country` *(optional)*: Country as an ISO code ('US', 'GB') or full name ('United States'). Defaults to United States.
- `language` *(optional)*: Language code. Defaults to en.
- `product_id` / `gid` / `data_docid` — at least one required.
  - `product_id`: Google Shopping product_id (from product-search). (one of: product_id, gid, data_docid — at least one required)
  - `gid`: Google Shopping gid (from product-search). (one of: product_id, gid, data_docid — at least one required)
  - `data_docid`: Google Shopping data_docid (from product-search). (one of: product_id, gid, data_docid — at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google_shopping/product?product_id=<product_id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /reviews — 1cr

Returns a unified ReviewList for a Google Shopping product, aggregated across retailers (each review's `source` is the hosting retailer domain). Each review carries the title, full text, star rating, author (when present), images, and publication date. Pass the product's gid (from product-search); product_id and data_docid are recommended for accuracy. Products with no Google Shopping reviews return 404 (auto-refunded).

**Parameters**

- `gid`: Google Shopping gid of the product (from product-search). Required.
- `product_id` *(optional)*: Google Shopping product_id (recommended for accuracy).
- `data_docid` *(optional)*: Google Shopping data_docid (recommended for accuracy).
- `depth` *(optional)*: Number of reviews to retrieve (default 10, multiples of 10, max 8000).
- `country` *(optional)*: Country as an ISO code ('US', 'GB') or full name ('United States'). Defaults to United States.
- `language` *(optional)*: Language code. Defaults to en.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google_shopping/reviews?gid=<gid>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /sellers — 1cr

Returns the list of sellers/offers for a single Google Shopping product: seller name, domain, itemised price (base/tax/shipping/total/currency), rating, product condition, availability, and any special-offer annotation. Pass any one of the opaque identifiers (product_id, gid, or data_docid) from product-search.

**Parameters**

- `country` *(optional)*: Country as an ISO code ('US', 'GB') or full name ('United States'). Defaults to United States.
- `language` *(optional)*: Language code. Defaults to en.
- `product_id` / `gid` / `data_docid` — at least one required.
  - `product_id`: Google Shopping product_id (from product-search). (one of: product_id, gid, data_docid — at least one required)
  - `gid`: Google Shopping gid (from product-search). (one of: product_id, gid, data_docid — at least one required)
  - `data_docid`: Google Shopping data_docid (from product-search). (one of: product_id, gid, data_docid — at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google_shopping/sellers?product_id=<product_id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```


## Choosing a Google Shopping endpoint

| Your goal | Use this | Credits |
|-----------|----------|---------|
| Find products for a keyword | `/product-search` | 5 |
| One product's detail | `/product` | 1 |
| What buyers say | `/reviews` | 1 |
| Who sells it and at what price | `/sellers` | 1 |

### The cost shape is inverted here — search is the expensive one

Unlike most retail platforms, the *search* costs 5cr and everything downstream is 1cr. Once
you hold a product id, detail, reviews and seller spread are 1cr each. So: search once, then
enrich freely.

`/sellers` (1cr) is the cross-retailer price view — the cheapest way in the whole API to see
what several retailers charge for the same item, since it aggregates rather than requiring one
call per store.

For reviews spanning Amazon and Trustpilot as well, `prism/product-reviews` (30cr) is the
one-call version.
